Plot Predator Abundance (Log Scale & Updated Scaling)

plot_predator_log_scaled.Rd

Visualizes abundance trends using a log-10 Y-axis. Harp seals are scaled by 10 (as requested), while other variables use their raw values. Includes regional tags (NWA/GSL) and distinct shapes for accessibility.

Usage

plot_predator_log_scaled(
  data = gslea::EA.data,
  year_col = year,
  var_col = variable,
  val_col = value,
  year_range = NULL,
  lang = "en",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = c(0.05, 0.95),
  base_size = 14
)

Arguments

data

A data frame. Defaults to gslea::EA.data.

year_col

Unquoted year column.

var_col

Unquoted variable column.

val_col

Unquoted value column.

year_range

Optional numeric vector c(start, end).

lang

Language: "en" (default) or "fr".

show_legend

Logical. Defaults to TRUE.

legend_position

Position of the legend. Defaults to c(0.05, 0.95).

base_size

Numeric. Defaults to 14.

Value

A ggplot object.
